entities.name: Query D-aminoacyl-tRNA deacylase
observations: 150 aa protein; exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A1BI65 from Chlorobium phaeobacteroides.
Annotated as a D-aminoacyl-tRNA editing enzyme that hydrolyzes mischarged D-aminoacyl-tRNAs and also glycyl-tRNA(Ala).
Contains the Tyr_Deacylase Pfam domain PF02580.23 across positions 4–145.
Predicted cytoplasmic localization and homodimeric assembly by the exact reference annotation.
Contains a Gly-cisPro motif at positions 138–139 associated with rejection of L-amino acids.

entities.name: D-aminoacyl-tRNA hydrolysis
observations: Catalyzes hydrolysis of D-aminoacyl-tRNA to free D-alpha-amino acid and tRNA; associated EC 3.1.1.96 and RHEA:13953/10123/10124.

entities.name: Gly-tRNA(Ala) hydrolysis
observations: Catalyzes hydrolysis of glycyl-tRNA(Ala) to glycine and tRNA(Ala); associated RHEA:13640/53744/9657.

entities.name: D-amino acid catabolic process
observations: The enzyme contributes to cellular removal and recycling of D-aminoacyl-tRNA species, supporting maintenance of protein L-homochirality.
